data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Real-Time Metrics Dashboard
features.description: Develop a real-time dashboard with Chart.js graphs for various metrics.
acceptance_criteria: LLM cost over time is displayed using a line chart.
Stage completion rates are shown with a bar chart.
Success rate trends are visualized with an area chart.

features.title: Code Quality Metrics Visualization
features.description: Visualize TDD compliance and SOLID principles using a radar chart.
acceptance_criteria: TDD compliance is shown on a radar chart.
SOLID principles are represented on the same chart.
The radar chart is clear and easy to interpret.

features.title: Chart.js Visualization Integration
features.description: Integrate Chart.js to visualize pipeline metrics, cost tracking, and success rates.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline metrics are visualized using Chart.js.
Cost tracking is displayed with appropriate charts.
Success rates are shown using Chart.js visualizations.

features.title: Display Real Metrics
features.description: Showcase real metrics from recent runs using actual data.
acceptance_criteria: Recent run data is accurately displayed.
Metrics are presented in a clear and understandable format.
Data is updated to reflect the most recent runs.

features.title: Supervisor Integration Visualization
features.description: Show supervisor integration across stages using a pie chart.
acceptance_criteria: A pie chart displays supervisor integration across stages.
The chart is interactive and updates with data changes.
Integration data is accurately represented.

features.title: Auto-Advance and Navigation Controls
features.description: Enable slides to auto-advance with user navigation controls.
acceptance_criteria: Slides auto-advance after a set duration.
Users can manually navigate between slides.
Navigation controls are intuitive and responsive.

features.title: HTML Presentation Creation
features.description: Develop a standalone HTML file with embedded CSS, JavaScript, and Chart.js for the Artemis self-demo.
acceptance_criteria: The HTML file is standalone with no external dependencies.
CSS and JavaScript are embedded within the HTML file.
Chart.js is included for data visualization.

features.title: Pipeline Visualization
features.description: Create an 8-stage pipeline visualization using Chart.js.
acceptance_criteria: The pipeline is accurately represented in 8 stages.
Each stage is clearly labeled and visually distinct.
Chart.js is used to create the visualization.

features.title: Professional Design and Transitions
features.description: Implement a professional gradient background and smooth transitions for the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: The presentation has a professional gradient background.
Transitions between slides are smooth and visually appealing.
Design elements are consistent with a professional theme.
